name: Gnoll Way Home
source:
You awaken in another world, inhabiting the body of one of the realm's most reviled beasts - the savage gnoll.  Before you can even come to grips with your situation, you are thrust into a journey to find your place in this world that fears and rejects your very presence. The path to discovering yourself is a dangerous one, but you won't walk that path alone.

[From [url=https://gnollwayhome.itch.io/gnoll-way-home]itch.io[/url]]
